data.hardware: 単一ノード8×NVIDIA A800 GPUで訓練・評価。
data.software: Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B target、5-layer DFlash drafter、draft block size 16。高並列serving throughputはSGLang上で測定。
data.methodology: 80K ShareGPT samplesで各target向けdrafterをscratch training。標準Multi-Round Self-Conditioned Trainingは初回mask round後にk=2 reject-conditioned rounds。評価は数学GSM8K/MATH-500、code HumanEval/MBPP、dialogue MT-Bench/Alpaca。低並列ではgreedy T=0とsampling T=1のaverage acceptance lengthをEAGLE-3/DFlashと比較。高並列ではQwen3-4B/8BのGSM8K/HumanEvalをconcurrency 1,2,4,8,16,32でbaseline autoregressive、EAGLE-3、DFlash、DFlow比較。relay ablation、runtime overhead、Domino互換性も評価。
data.scope: target modelはQwen3 1.7B/4B/8Bに限定。block diffusion drafterはDFlash系が中心で、他のtarget familiesやproduction heterogeneous hardwareは未評価。高並列は最大32 concurrency、単一8×A800 node。
